label: Bible Study
prompt: A time to be born, and a time to _____; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verse: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
note: The second verse of 'a time for everything' — the list starts at birth and works from there.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: (For the LORD thy God is a _____ God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verse: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
note: Moses's guarantee for the far future: a merciful God will not forsake thee or forget His covenant.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And if a house be _____ against itself, that house cannot stand.
verse: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
note: Lincoln borrowed it in 1858; Jesus first said it to critics who claimed he cast out devils by the devil's power.

label: Deep Water
prompt: In that day shall there be upon the _____ of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
verse: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
note: 'Holiness to the LORD' was engraved on the high priest's mitre — Zechariah sees it on horses' bells.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy _____ out of his place, except thou repent.
verse: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
note: To Ephesus, who had left their first love: repent, or I will 'remove thy candlestick' — the church's lamp.
